plan.reference: Primary monotone elastica from complete/incomplete elliptic integrals; continuous tangent by analytic ODE sensitivities; both tip-compliance modes.
limitations: Synthetic clamped/free, massless inextensible beam with a tip mass; no native ISAE output.
Lateral dead load is specified at 2% of axial compression, selecting the branch; it is not fitted to a reference.
Dense N8 is a coarse control only; final accuracy uses N64/N128.

browser.scope: One complete modal worker calculation; no whole-family or native ASWING validation claim.
